phishing.label: Phishing / security lures
phishing.description: Account, security, payment and delivery language that phishing kits imitate; the highest-risk bucket in Prospeo, Autobound, Overloop and GetResponse. A cold email has no reason to use it.

deceptive.label: Deceptive framing
deceptive.description: Fake reply chains, fake prior relationships, generic greetings, spam-law disclaimers, prize and advance-fee framing. Gmail guidelines and SpamAssassin DEAR_* / EXCUSE_* rules weight deception, not vocabulary.
deceptive.reason: Looks deceptive to filters and readers.

money.label: Money / earnings
money.description: Income, debt, credit, loans, investment and get-rich claims; Tier-1 consensus on 10-20 vendor lists and the core of SpamAssassin's financial rules.

guarantee.label: Guarantee / overpromise
guarantee.description: Guarantees, risk-free and no-obligation claims; SpamAssassin GUARANTEED_100_PERCENT 2.699 and 16 vendor lists.

health.label: Health / pharma / gambling / adult
health.description: Weight loss, drugs, pharmacy, sexual, gambling and adult content; the most heavily scored SpamAssassin body rules and a regulated-claims category under FTC/FDA enforcement.
health.reason: Health and gambling claims get scrutiny.

urgency.label: Urgency / scarcity
urgency.description: Pressure and scarcity language; SpamAssassin scores it 0.1-2.8, and Belkins finds 'now'/'ASAP' subjects open at 36% vs 46%. Escalates when stacked.
urgency.reason: Pressure reads as a mass blast.

discount.label: Free / discount
discount.description: Free, discount and price-led offers; 15 lists flag them, but a lone 'free' is low-risk and most are normal in opted-in newsletters.
discount.reason: Promo phrasing. Fine once, risky stacked.

tech.label: Tech / crypto
tech.description: Crypto, NFT, SEO, lead-list and AI-powered pitches; Prospeo rates crypto High, and list-selling spam is a reputation risk.
tech.reason: Crypto and AI hype lower trust.

hype.label: Hype / social-proof claims
hype.description: Superlatives, buzzwords and unverifiable social proof; Gong/30MPC data shows pitch-first language cuts replies by up to 57%. Quality lint, not a filter trigger.

cliche.label: Cliches / AI vocabulary
cliche.description: Cold-outreach cliches and LLM-excess vocabulary (Kobak et al. 2025, Woodpecker, Prospeo); reply-rate lint with no filter-level evidence.
cliche.reason: Template phrasing. Readers skim past it.
